name: hud_ui_widget_set_pos
description: HudUiWidget::SetPos stores x/y directly unless alignFlags and image are both present, then stores center-adjusted coordinates and invalidates through ftable slot 8.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4b3dd0 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiWidget/source-file table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b3dd0 validates direct x/y storage when alignFlags is zero or image is null, center-adjusted storage using image width/height halves when both are present, and ftable slot 8 invalidate dispatch on both paths.

The native widget constructor smoke covers unaligned SetPos, positive image center adjustment, negative image center adjustment, and invalidation. The background cursor smokes cover the caller that delegates to HudUiWidget::SetPos before rebuilding captured cursor imagery.
